ENFJ.description: ENFJs are charismatic leaders driven by empathy and purpose. They naturally inspire others, foster collaboration, and care deeply about the people around them. They are warm, persuasive, and idealistic, often taking responsibility for group harmony. However, they may neglect their own needs while focusing on others. Learning self-care allows them to sustain their energy and continue empowering others.
